articles.title: What happens when no hurricanes hit the Gulf? Texas just found out.
articles.summary: For the first time in a decade, the Atlantic hurricane season concluded without a major storm making landfall on U.S. shores. While offering domestic respite, it doesn't imply a globally inactive season. This underscores the unpredictable nature of extreme weather, emphasizing the ongoing importance of national disaster preparedness, resource allocation, and robust infrastructure for future challenges.

articles.title: Infernal Hulk #2 Preview: Hulk's Atlantis Adventure Goes Awry
articles.summary: Infernal Hulk #2 previews the green goliath's attack on Atlantis, where an ancient evil soon intervenes with its own agenda. The upcoming Marvel comic also delves into the mystery surrounding Bruce Banner's current whereabouts. This issue promises intense fictional conflict and a compelling character mystery within the ongoing Hulk saga, highlighting a new major plot development.

articles.title: DRDO hands over 7 technologies developed under tech development fund to armed forces
articles.summary: The DRDO recently transferred seven advanced defence technologies, including a long-life seawater battery for sustained underwater sensing and a waterjet propulsion system for fast interceptor craft, to the Indian Navy and industry. These indigenous developments aim to enhance India's maritime capabilities, improve surveillance, and bolster the operational readiness of its naval forces, reinforcing national security and self-reliance in critical defence technologies.
